summary: FAIL: 1 hard and 3 soft violations, plus 5 advisories that are not counted. Hard V1 (L159): the narration says Sylvanas thought she was following 'one man, a young man with a cart' while she was at the Pass and in Millhaven. She knew of no grain man at the Pass, and in Ch3 L457 she dismissed him in Millhaven. The one-man judgment is from Ch4, so the list should name only Ch4 moments. Soft V2 (L275, L217, L537): Tam sat on the poison 'all summer' or 'for a summer', but Ch4 L706, said in Sylvanas's hearing, has him arriving at the back end of summer. Soft V3 (L141 against L65 and L149): Millhaven's first short-rate load is dated both 'first week of the summer' and 'midsummer'. Soft V4 (L661): the woman sweeping the chapel step is named as a possible source for warning the depot, but she only saw them after the depot was swept. All four fixes are line-level. Everything else holds. The opening matches Ch4's close. The mage/Jaina narration switch lands exactly at B7 (L641), and aloud it stays Mage or Proudmoore. All readings come through Jaina's staff. The rut and rain logic and the overseer's 'two days ago' are consistent. The overseer is alive, gone and never shown again. The Barov name stays a connection, not a verdict. The carter callback matches the Ch3 page and is not conflated with the cart man. Arthas and Strahnbrad have three on-page sources before the B9 road choice, which rests on Jaina's read. No Mal'Ganis or Kel'Thuzad, and Neral is absent.
